known_limitations: L'API Vercel idle-processor peut être indisponible → fallback local obligatoire
Ne pas générer de SQL ALTER TABLE — créer une issue migration
Le build peut échouer si on touche à des fichiers de typages sans mettre à jour les déclarations
Toujours vérifier que npm test && npm run build passent avant de commit
Boss PvE: un kill 1-shot en une journée est IMPOSSIBLE par construction (pool = 12x maxHp, boss scale 1.2x) — médiane ~4 jours, c'est le design voulu

preferred_patterns.naming: camelCase pour variables, PascalCase pour types/interfaces
preferred_patterns.tests: TDD : écrire le test avant l'implémentation
preferred_patterns.error_handling: Utiliser try/catch avec fallback, pas de throw non géré
preferred_patterns.optional_chaining: Toujours utiliser ?. et ?? pour les champs optionnels (surtout Supabase)

session_notes.lesson: QA stats shop purchase field is null for legacy runs - cannot compute purchase rates from historical data alone. Essence per run must be computed from lootbox item rarities and ESSENCE_YIELD, not from actual forge activity which isnt tracked.

PR #487 fix: completed missing shop price adjustment (150/250/350) based on essence economy ratio (13.1/18.5 ≈ 0.708). Purchase rate 0% < 10% threshold triggered price reduction. Updated shopConstants.ts, shop-utils.test.ts, shop-panel.test.tsx.

PR #487 CI fix: Remote feat/auto-483 branch was polluted with unrelated workflow file changes (.github/workflows/opencode.yml, reviewer.yml) that violate project rules and break CI. Solution: rebased local clean branch on master and force-pushed to overwrite. The inline reviewer in master's opencode.yml (commit baf7302) automatically detected the clean PR and merged it. Root cause of original CI failure: ci.yml dispatch step tries to run gh workflow run reviewer.yml which fails because workflow_dispatch is not recognized on master. Master's fix (baf7302) bypasses this with inline review in opencode.yml.

Pity counter unbounded growth fix: When forceLegendaryRoll() returns null (no legendary items in eligible pool at low levels), the pity counter must be reset via recursive rollLootbox() call with pityCount=0 to prevent unbounded growth. Simple fall-through to normal roll would keep incrementing the counter forever.

QA bot equipment capture fix: body text fallback item names can be corrupted emoji remnants. Validation must check for actual alphanumeric content (/[a-zA-Z]/) and minimum length >= 2, not just truthy/empty. Also added wait after inventory click for DOM reliability.

CombatView already had a mount-level setTimeout for hard timeout (45s), but setTimeout can be throttled by browsers in background tabs. Added a second wall-clock guard using Date.now() inside the round interval callback that checks elapsed time at each 520ms tick. This dual-layer approach (Date.now() poll + setTimeout safety net) ensures the hard timeout cannot be bypassed even when the browser throttles timers. The mount-level setTimeout must be kept as a redundant safety net for edge cases where the round interval is not running (e.g., during intro/vs phases).

PvE XP investigation #477: Traced PvE XP flow in useArenaCombat.ts — onCombatComplete applies GAME_RULES.PVE.XP_MODIFIER (0.80) to xpGained from calculateFightXp. CombatView shows pre-modifier XP (from calculateFightXp) while the actual saved XP is post-modifier. Added console.warn logging at point of modification to capture before/after values in browser console. QA bot now captures xp_before_modifier and xp_after_modifier fields for PvE fights. Analysis script computes pve_xp_ratio comparing actual saved PvE XP to PvP win XP. 6 new tests pass. Root cause: XP calculation itself is correct (uses XP_WIN=90 for wins), but the 27% ratio in issue data may stem from QA data mixing pre-modifier display values or old XP formula data. The logging/metrics added will enable data-driven diagnosis.

PvE difficulty adjustment: PVE.STAT_MULTIPLIER 10->11 and PVE.HP_MULTIPLIER 11->12 to address 100% PvE win rate. Simple config change with test assertions. TDD flow followed: tests updated first (RED), then source values (GREEN), lint + build verified.

Issue #547 - Legendary lootbox drop rate 0% after 133 opens: Root cause was that legendary items only existed at level 5+, but QA characters (and most early-game players) are level 1-4. The 4% legendary weight was effectively 0% because no legendary items existed in the eligible pool. Fix: added 2 low-level legendary items (Mystic Eye at level 3, Serrated Fang at level 4) so the 4% weight becomes meaningful for early-game players. Tests: updated item count from 136→138 and legendary spread assertions.

QA bot idle/PvE classification fix: Added structured idle_fights[] records from idle_runner observation data. Removed idle data merge from pve_data so pve_data only reflects active PvE fights. Updated analyzer to read idle_fights with legacy idle_runner fallback, added idle to fight_type_breakdown with separate win rate. The 3 fight types are now cleanly separated: pvp (active PvP), pve (active PvE via FIGHT button), idle (auto-resolve idle observation).

PvE difficulty adjustment: PVE.STAT_MULTIPLIER 15->20, HP_MULTIPLIER 17->22, LEVEL_BOOST 2->3 to address 100% PvE win rate (QA: 15 fights, 100% WR). Simple config change with test assertions updated first (RED), then source values (GREEN). Full suite 1127 tests + lint + build verified before commit. Stale comment in combat-pve.test.ts also updated to reflect new values.

Issue #584 - QA bot time budget: Made idle observation configurable (idleObservationMs default 20s, was 30s hardcoded but observed 57s due to setup waits). Added global timeBudgetMs (8 min default) guard that propagates a deadline into observeIdleCombat polling loop (effectiveDeadline = min(endTime, deadline)), stops fight sequence early, and skips idle/forge/shop/offline-gains phases with clean skipped-result factories (createSkippedForgeResult/createSkippedShopResult) instead of throwing. Also skips idle screenshot when budget exceeded. Pattern: for long-running E2E scripts, use module-level runStartTime + deadline-aware loops + graceful skip factories rather than hard timeouts.

QA bot forge/shop never tested: qa/qa-bot.config.js unlock levels were desynced from src/config/progressionConfig.ts (forgeUnlockLevel: 10 vs FORGE_UNLOCK_LEVEL: 1). Fixed pvpUnlockLevel 5->1, forgeUnlockLevel 10->1. Shop stays 20 (matches game) with explicit skip_reason. Added qa-bot.config.d.ts so vitest/tsc can type-check the JS config, and sync tests importing PROGRESSION_GATES.

Issue #583 (Web Push Notifications, Proposition majeure avec /oc) était trop large (SW + Web Push API + migration DB + UI + scheduler + tests, 6+ fichiers sur 5 sous-systèmes). Appliqué la règle campagne: créé 5 sous-issues avec /oc + label campaign-583 (#588-592) et 1 issue migration SANS /oc (#587) pour validation humaine, puis STOP sans coder. Le texte de l'issue est trompeur: malgré 'Type: Proposition majeure (validation humaine)', le tag /oc impose l'implémentation — mais via sous-issues. Pattern: utiliser --body-file pour les issues gh quand le body contient des apostrophes/backticks (sinon syntax error shell).

Issue #590 reminder scheduler: no event config exists yet in the codebase (src/config has no event source). The event rule must be implemented with an injectable events array param (ActiveEvent[]), defaulting to empty so it gracefully skips. This keeps getReminderType pure and future-proof for sub-issue #583 later steps. Priority streak_danger > lootbox > event, max 1 notification/day enforced via shouldSendToday using getDailyResetKey comparison.

Issue infra #596 (migrer CI/reviewer vers workflow_run) : la modification de .github/workflows/*.yml est interdite au dev agent. Correctif: créer une issue HUMAIN SANS /oc (#597) avec les diffs YAML exacts, commenter l issue parente, et NE PAS coder. Le workflow_dispatch reste le workaround. Branch protection master confirmee vide.

Issue #599 /oc demandait d'exécuter #597 (migration CI/reviewer vers workflow_run). Blocage: #597 est 100% infra .github/workflows/*.yml (modification interdite au dev agent, renvoyée par la CI) + réglages GitHub Settings (approbation PRs bots) accessibles uniquement en HTTP 403 pour l'integration token. Aucun code src/ exigé. Réponse correcte: commenter #599 avec les preuves (403 + diffs dans #597 + workaround workflow_dispatch), NE PAS créer de branch vide, laisser issue ouverte à l'action humaine. Pattern confirmé: /oc ne peut pas déroger à la contrainte absolue sur les fichiers de workflow.

Issue #592 (Web Push persistence): convertToSupabase must NOT emit push columns (push_endpoint/push_keys/push_subscribed) on the default no-fields sync path — migration #587 not yet applied, PostgREST returns PGRST204 for unknown columns and would break EVERY debounced sync (dbAvailable=false). Solution: push fields are only emitted when explicitly requested via the fields param (convertToSupabase(char, [push_endpoint, push_keys, push_subscribed])), plus a buildPushSubscriptionUpdate() helper returning the exact 3-field payload for the banner. Reminder flow: usePushReminders hook fires trySendPushReminder on login/load (1/jour via localStorage key bitbrawler_last_push_sent).

Issue #616 (Vercel deployments failing - all deployments after 20:52 UTC): pure infra issue outside dev-agent scope. Evidence gathered: npm run lint clean, 1207/1207 tests pass, npm run build OK (tsc+vite), latest master commit 1888f7d shows ONLY status = Vercel failure ('Deployment has failed - run npx vercel inspect dpl_... --logs'). No VERCEL_TOKEN in CI env so Vercel CLI inspect is impossible. Pattern of 'ALL deployments fail regardless of content while same code passes locally' = platform-side issue (quota/billing, global incident status.vercel.com, or Vercel build config/env var), NOT repo regression. Correct action: post evidence comment to issue #616, do NOT push empty branch, leave issue OPEN for human with Vercel access. Consistent with infra patterns #597/#599.

Testing hooks that schedule setTimeout (e.g. useArenaLevelUp stagger queue) with vi.useFakeTimers: ALL mock functions (play, setCharacter, saveStatAllocations, clearXpNotifications) passed to the hook MUST be created ONCE outside the renderHook callback (stable identity). If recreated inside the callback on every render, any effect whose deps include those mocks (e.g. cleanup effect dep [clearXpNotifications]) re-runs on each render and clears the pending timers (levelUpQueueRef/levelUpTimerRef) - so recentLevelUp gets stuck and vi.getTimerCount() drops to 0. Fix: create stable mocks per-hook. Correct pattern: separate sync act() + vi.advanceTimersByTime() steps, assert after each. Also note: reading result.current INSIDE an async act callback is stale; read between acts.

Boss PvE (VOID TITAN): migration #625 executée par l'humain → sync boss_progress activée de bout en bout. Câblage: CharacterRow.boss_progress (config/supabase.ts), convertFromSupabase/convertToSupabase (omis si undefined pour ne jamais nuller les données serveur), payload de useBossFight inclut boss_progress, merge au load = bestChar.bossProgress ?? localChar.bossProgress, sync debounced (convertToSupabase complet) inclus. Equilibrage Monte-Carlo: kill day-1 impossible par construction (pool 12x maxHp, boss scale 1.2x), médiane ~4 jours, killRate 10j = 100%. Tests: arena-boss.test.tsx (4), round-trip supabase-utils (2), bossUtils (26), bossBalance (3). Piège test integration: characterToSupabaseRow (test/utils/supabaseMock.ts) n'émet PAS essence/boss_progress → le merge au load garde le serveur (XP égale) et essence=0 ; pour garder la version locale il faut lui donner plus de XP (hasMoreXp). Total suite: 1264 tests verts.

Issue #627 PvE XP ratio 0.509: game code correct (useArenaCombat.ts applies GAME_RULES.PVE.XP_MODIFIER=2.5). Root cause = STALE QA tooling constant: qa/qa-bot.mjs had PVE_XP_MODIFIER=0.80 (so xp_after_modifier=79*0.80=63) and scripts/analyze-qa-stats.ts expectedRatio=0.80. Both updated to 2.5. Improved tautological combat-pve.test.ts test to assert PvE win XP strictly > PvP win XP at all levels. Pattern: when QA stats contradict game constants, audit the parsing/label constants FIRST before touching game balance. 1265 tests green.

Issue #630: qa-bot.mjs line 1714 used shorthand `levels_gained,` in object literal but local was camelCase `levelsGained` -> ReferenceError crashed every QA run on level-up (avg_fights_per_run 4.52->1.2, win rate 0% artifact). Fix: explicit `levels_gained: levelsGained,`. Analyzer (analyze-qa-stats.ts LevelUpEvent) reads snake_case key - correct choice. Added static source-shape regression test in qa-analysis.test.ts reading qa/qa-bot.mjs via process.cwd() (import.meta.url breaks under jsdom, ERR_INVALID_URL_SCHEME) asserting explicit key present and no bare shorthand. Pattern: for E2E scripts that cant be unit-tested, guard against runtime ReferenceError via source-content assertion on the exact object literal key.

Issue #637 QA bot overlay deadlock: inventory-overlay intercepted Settings/Inventory clicks (50 timeouts, 6 runs failed). Fix in qa/qa-bot.mjs only: (1) dismissModals(page) helper = Escape -> force-click .retro-modal-overlay -> force-click .lootbox-result-overlay -> waitForSelector('.retro-modal-overlay', {state:'detached', timeout:3000}) returning bool; (2) addLocatorHandler for .inventory-overlay clicking .inventory-close + backdrop force; (3) syncAutoMode calls dismissModals before settingsBtn.click(); (4) handleDailyLootbox: ALL 5 silent closeInventory.click().catch(()=>{}) replaced with console.warn + dismissModals fallback + waitForSelector('.inventory-overlay',{state:'detached'}). Tests: source-content regression suite 'QA Bot Overlay Deadlock Contract' in qa-analysis.test.ts using extractAsyncFunction + requireAsyncFunction (TS guard helper: expect().not.toBeNull() does NOT narrow - use explicit null check + throw). Gotcha: selector strings live inside longer selectors so assert substring '.inventory-close' not quoted exact match. 1275 tests green, lint + build OK.

Issue #634: useArenaCombat.test.ts tested a MOCK mirror of the OLD pre-#633 logic (pve branch calling usePveFight with XP_MODIFIER + console.warn '[PvE XP]'). After the boss-toggle removal, the mirror was rewritten to match the real production onCombatComplete: only 'boss' branch (useBossFight with bossHpLeft ?? opponent.hp) and fallback useFight. Removed GAME_RULES import. Also simplified pveMonster state in useArenaCombat.ts (dropped the never-read monsterDef: unknown field, keeping only monsterId which Arena.tsx consumes) and marked usePveFight in GameContext as @deprecated (still exported + used by legacy integration tests, just no longer called from Arena). Gotcha: vitest 1.6 Mock generic takes a params TUPLE not a function type — use `Mock<[won: boolean, xpGained: number, ...], Promise<FightResult | null>>` with `vi.fn<Tuple, ReturnType>()`, NOT `Mock<FunctionType>`. Test suite 1273 green, lint + build OK.

Issue #645 QA bot deadlock v2: the #637 .inventory-overlay locator handler dismisses the inventory on EVERY intercepted action, so handleDailyLootbox (which needs the overlay OPEN to click the lootbox button inside it) deadlocks -> 30s timeout (14 consecutive failed runs). CRITICAL Playwright semantic: a bare `return` guard in the handler is NOT enough — after the handler runs, Playwright calls waitForSelector(handler.selector, {state: hidden}) unless the handler was registered with { noWaitAfter: true }; with noWaitAfter, a suppressed handler still lets the click proceed (button is inside the overlay = clickable). Fix: module flag suppressInventoryHandler + guard in handler + { noWaitAfter: true } + set flag before inventoryBtn.click() and re-arm on EVERY exit path (5 post-flag returns: 4 early + main). Exception aborts the whole run (outer catch closes browser) so stuck flag on throw is harmless. Regression tests: source-content contract asserting every return after the set re-arms the flag (returnsAfter == unsets count). 1283 tests green.

Issue #653 QA bot deadlock v3: syncAutoMode's composite locator '[role="switch"][aria-label="Auto mode"], [role="switch"], .pixel-switch'.first() resolved to the PvE switch (ActionPanel, higher in DOM) instead of the Auto mode switch inside the settings modal -> click intercepted by settings-overlay -> 30s timeout on 94 runs. Fix in qa/qa-bot.mjs only: (1) strict locator page.getByRole('switch', { name: 'Auto mode' }).first() with NO generic [role="switch"] fallback; (2) verify settings overlay opened via waitForSelector('.retro-modal-overlay.settings-overlay', {state:'visible'}) before clicking switch, return false if not; (3) retry pattern (force click + re-verify aria-checked) after first toggle. Kept dismissModals() before settingsBtn.click(). Tests: 3 source-content regression assertions in the 'QA Bot Overlay Deadlock Contract' describe (strict locator present + composite absent, overlay check before click, retry force click after first click + re-check after force click). Gotcha: when asserting retry ordering, search the second getAttribute('aria-checked') AFTER the forceClick index, not after the first occurrence. 1314 tests green, lint + build OK.

Issue #661 (Biome engine, effort 4+): campaign rule applied — created sub-issues [1/4]=#662 (pre-existing), [2/4]=#663 (pre-existing, BiomeTerrain), [3/4]=#665 (volcanic monster pool + biome-filtered getRandomMonsterId), [4/4]=#666 (SceneBox + useIdleCombat integration) with /oc + label campaign-661, posted DAG plan on parent, STOP without coding. GOTCHA: parallel dispatches of the SAME parent issue create duplicate sub-issues seconds apart (#664, #667, #668). After creating sub-issues, ALWAYS re-scan gh issue list --label campaign-N and close duplicates (keep earliest + most precise body) to avoid two agents implementing the same deliverable concurrently. Pattern: gh issue close <dup> --comment explaining the duplicate and canonical issue.

Issue #662 biome registry: getBiomeForCharacter 'first biome whose unlockAt returns true' is a trap — if a missing unlockAt is treated as true, the default biome (plains, first in registry) always matches and gated biomes (volcanic) become dead code (volcanic-unlock tests fail: plains always wins). Correct semantics: only a DEFINED unlockAt returning true matches (find), and the default biome (BIOMES[0]) is the fallback via ?? BIOMES[0]. Plains stays 'first' by position = default, not by gate. Plains pool derived from MONSTER_ASSETS.map(id) (data-driven, auto-tracks new monsters); volcanic pool falls back to the same pool until sub-issue 3. Suite: 1333 tests green, lint + build OK.

Issue #665 (biome engine [3/4] volcanic pool): getRandomMonsterId signature extended to (playerLevel, biomeId?, exclude?) — the 2nd positional arg is now biomeId, NOT exclude. Any legacy call passing exclude as 2nd arg silently breaks (exclude ignored → 'ogre' can reappear). Fix: update callers to getRandomMonsterId(level, undefined, exclude). Also: when adding MonsterId values, exhaustive Record<MonsterId, number> (monsterVisualScale.ts) must be updated or tsc fails. Volcanic pool in biomes.ts must exclude volcanic monsters from plains pool (PLAINS = MONSTER_ASSETS minus VOLCANIC) to keep exclusivity; biome test asserting volcanic==plains fallback must be updated to the real pool.

Biome campaign #661 parallel dispatch: #666 (4/4) is compile-coupled to #663 (BiomeTerrain) + #665 (generateMonsterForPlayer biomeId). Verified locally with TEMPORARY untracked shims (BiomeTerrain.tsx + monsterUtils biomeId param), confirmed all my tests pass, then reverted shims and rebased onto master once deps merged (PRs #672/#673). Only residual failure during shim phase was monster-utils.test.ts getRandomMonsterId(10,"ogre") — the #665-owned test update, NOT mine. Also re-confirmed #620 lesson: useIdleCombat offline effect loops forever if onCharacterUpdate/onSyncCharacter are recreated inside the renderHook callback (stable-identity mocks required); microtask flush via await Promise.resolve() loop, not vi.runAllTicks().

Issue #666 (biome engine [4/4]) re-dispatched in parallel: first run merged a clean implementation via PR #678 (issue auto-closed 15:28), while a parallel run force-pushed its own version to the SAME branch feat/auto-666 (4e9524f) and created duplicate PR #680. My own implementation (27361b6) was a third redundant copy. Correct handling when an issue is already merged: (1) NEVER push redundant code — it creates PR churn and force-push wars on the same branch; (2) close duplicate PRs with a comment referencing the canonical merged PR (#678); (3) reset local branch to origin/master + git push origin --delete <branch> so the workflow's 'push & manage PR' step finds 0 commits vs master and exits cleanly instead of creating a new feature PR from stale branch commits; (4) let the standard memory-only commit/PR flow happen. ALSO: master's merged BiomeTerrain (#672) has NO .biome-terrain class nor data-biome attribute and uses biomeId?: string (optional) — never write test selectors against a parallel agent's copy; inspect the actual merged DOM/props first. The merged #678 SceneBox intentionally dropped the old 'pveMode &&' gate (biome follows the character even in PvP) — accepted design, do not 'fix' it.

Issue #685 QA bot forge lock timeout: qa/qa-bot.config.js forgeUnlockLevel was 1 (from #582, matched FORGE_UNLOCK_LEVEL=1 = Salvage only) but the bot's testForgeSystem CLICKS the Fusion/Upgrade tabs which are gated at FUSION_UNLOCK_LEVEL=15/UPGRADE_UNLOCK_LEVEL=15. Playwright click() waits for 'enabled' on disabled buttons -> 30s timeout on 10 consecutive runs (win_rate 0% artifact). Fix: (1) forgeUnlockLevel -> 15 (max forge gate, assert against FUSION_UNLOCK_LEVEL not FORGE_UNLOCK_LEVEL in sync tests); (2) new isTabLocked(locator) helper = isDisabled() OR title includes 'Unlocks at LVL' (locked tabs in Forge.tsx/InventoryPanel.tsx have BOTH disabled attr AND title='Unlocks at LVL 15/20'); (3) guard fusion/upgrade/shop tab clicks BEFORE isVisible+click, returning createSkippedForgeResult/createSkippedShopResult instead of timing out. Pattern: for Playwright scripts, detect disabled/locked state via isDisabled()/getAttribute('title') BEFORE click() — click() on a disabled button blocks until timeout. Source-content contract tests in qa-analysis.test.ts (QA Bot Locked Tab Skip Contract) mirror the #637/#645/#653 pattern. Full suite 1369 tests green, lint + build OK.

Le pity lootbox était un useState session-only dans GameContext — jamais persisté (ni localStorage ni Supabase), donc reset à chaque reload : le pity garanti (30 rolls) ne déclenchait jamais. Fix: persister lootboxPityCount sur le Character (normalizeCharacter + persistCharacter) + sync Supabase best-effort via le champs fields uniquement (migration #692, PGRST204 ignoré silencieusement pour ne pas casser le roll). Bug UI: InventoryPanel affichait /75 au lieu de PITY_THRESHOLD (30).

Issue #696: analyze-qa-stats.ts was polluted by QA bot character-replacement runs. Since #695 (merge 08-13), runs with character_action=created-after-missing-fight-cta/created-after-exhausted-energy replace the character mid-run: initial_max_hp read on OLD char, final_max_hp on NEW char → hp_analysis avg_hp_growth 13.8 mixed characters, essence_analysis avg -128.55 (n=5) triggered erroneous 'Players may be hoarding essence' suggestion. Fix: isCharacterReplacedRun() helper (final_max_hp < initial_max_hp - 10 OR character_action startsWith 'created-after-' with replaced_character set) applied to BOTH HP and essence analysis; new visibility field runs_excluded_by_character_replacement on both. Verified: essence now uses 3 healthy runs (+8.16/run), hoarding suggestion gone. Pattern: when QA stats contradict expectations, check for run-level data-quality artifacts (character replacement) BEFORE reading it as a balance signal. Test pattern: mirror function + source-content contract test reading scripts/analyze-qa-stats.ts (like qa-bot.mjs contract tests).

Issue #606 unlock gate lowering (15/15/20 -> 5/6/8): QA data (236 runs, avg end level ~2.5, only 1 run reached lvl 11) proved FUSION/UPGRADE/SHOP gates at 15/15/20 were unreachable. Changed src/config/progressionConfig.ts (FUSION 5, UPGRADE 6, SHOP 8) + qa/qa-bot.config.js (forgeUnlockLevel 15->6 = max forge tab gate, shopUnlockLevel 20->8). Pattern: forgeUnlockLevel sync test now asserts Math.max(FUSION_UNLOCK_LEVEL, UPGRADE_UNLOCK_LEVEL) instead of FUSION_UNLOCK_LEVEL alone (future-proof: Upgrade gate can exceed Fusion). Added a discovery-staircase regression test (Forge < Fusion < Upgrade < Shop) so future gate tweaks preserve the escalation. No DB migration needed (config-only). Full suite 1391 tests green, lint + build OK. NOTE: UPGRADE_UNLOCK_LEVEL is declared but NOT enforced in Forge.tsx UI (only Fusion tab is gated) — the bot's isTabLocked check on the Upgrade tab is a no-op in the current UI, keep as-is.

Issue #702: QA bot fight timeout 45s -> 90s. Root cause: tanky lvl 12-14 fights (max 94.8s, median 15.7s) exceed the old 45s total budget -> 44% of runs hit 'timeout waiting for result' -> partial runs (avg 4.69/5 fights). Fix is config-only: qa/qa-bot.config.js fightTimeout default '45000' -> '90000' (env QA_FIGHT_TIMEOUT overridable). Retry mechanism preserved (3 retries, budget split 50% + 50% + remainder via baseTimeout = floor(fightTimeout * 0.5)). TDD: added assertion in qa-bot-config.test.ts 'fightTimeout default is 90000ms' (RED: got 45000 -> GREEN after config change). Suite 1403 tests green, lint + build OK. Impact expected: fights of 45-90s now pass, only >90s fail (rare). Game-side root fix tracked in #697 (Sudden Death 30s, awaiting human validation).

Issue #706: SHOP_UNLOCK_LEVEL 8->5 aligned with FUSION_UNLOCK_LEVEL (5) to unblock QA shop data (65 runs skipped, avg end level 2-5 never reached 8). Staircase test Forge(1)<Fusion(5)<Upgrade(6)<Shop(8) was updated to Forge(1)<Fusion(5)=Shop(5)<Upgrade(6) — Shop no longer the strict top of the escalation, it aligns with Fusion. qa-bot.config.js shopUnlockLevel 8->5 (sync test auto-covers). Config-only change, no DB migration. 1403 tests green, lint + build OK.

Issue #705 QA bot PvE pipeline dead since 08-05: since #633 (boss-toggle removal), the arena's PvE mode launches the raid boss fight (LOCKED LVL 30) instead of monsters. The bot's isPveLocked fallback silently converted every PvE attempt to PvP, so pve_data.fights=0 on all runs. Fix applied A+B: (1) Option A: runFightSequence now records a PvE-observation — pve_data.pve_shifted=true + boss_locked_level + boss_name/HP from new captureBossStatus() helper (reads .boss-hp-name/.boss-hp-num which only render when boss unlocked, falls back to BOSS_NAME='VOID TITAN' constant) — instead of silently falling back; (2) Option B: if currentLevel >= bossLockedLevel (parsed from LOCKED LVL label via bossLockedLevel on readArenaStatus), launch a real fight via new captureBossFight() producing fight_type:'boss' records (monster_name: BOSS_NAME, boss_hp_left/boss_max_hp). Also: pve_data now initialized with pve_shifted:false and populated with boss_fights/boss_wins; pveOnly+locked-boss now breaks instead of the old endless character-replacement loop. Analyzer (analyze-qa-stats.ts): FightRecord.fight_type extended with 'boss', pve_data shape extended, PveAnalysis gained pve_shifted/boss_observations/boss_fights/boss_win_rate/boss_avg_xp_per_fight/boss_avg_hp_left; pvpFights and pvpWinsForRatio now exclude boss fights; fight_type_breakdown gained boss_fights+boss_win_rate; an ISSUE is emitted when pve_shifted is detected (monster PvE stale, see #705). Pattern: when QA stats contradict config expectations (pveRatio 0.33 but 0 PvE fights), audit what the game UI actually does in that mode FIRST (PvE switch = boss fight now) before touching game balance. 14 new tests (mirror + source-content contract, following #637/#645/#653/#685/#696 patterns), full suite 1417 green, lint+build OK.

Issue #710 QA bot equipment deadlock: root cause was NOT the DOM selectors (they match current InventoryPanel: .inv-loadout-slots, .inv-loadout-slot.filled, .inv-loadout-item-name, .inv-loadout-slot-icon all correct). Root cause = the .inventory-overlay locator handler (added #637, refined #645) fires on EVERY Playwright action while the overlay is visible, closing the inventory mid-parse. handleDailyLootbox sets suppressInventoryHandler=true before opening inventory + re-arms on all exits, but parseEquippedItems and parseStreak did NOT → DOM parse always yielded 0 → body fallback captured garbage (group labels 'WEAPONS'/'ARMOR'/'ACCESSORIES' from SLOT_LABELS '⚔️ WEAPONS' etc., and '️ ARMOR' = U+FE0F variation selector remnant) → 18 runs empty equipment + streak null. Fix: (1) suppressInventoryHandler=true in parseEquippedItems + parseStreak before opening inventory, detect already-open overlay (skip button click), re-arm=false on ALL exit paths; (2) parseEquippedItemsFromBody hardened: sanitizeItemName strips leading emoji/variation-selector (️) via /\p{Extended_Pictographic}/u + trailing '×', EQUIPMENT_GROUP_LABELS rejection (letters-only match), peek next line when icon and name are on separate rendered lines (innerText puts .inv-loadout-slot-icon on its own line, then item name, then × unequip button), debug log of EQUIPPED section lines when empty; (3) analyze-qa-stats.ts computeEquipmentAnalysis filters corrupted names (isValidEquippedItemName) counting only runs with ≥1 valid name. Pattern: any QA-bot function that opens the inventory and reads inside it MUST suppress the .inventory-overlay handler, not just handleDailyLootbox. Test gotcha: pre-existing #645 test used indexOf first 'page.locator(.inventory-overlay)' which now hits the new alreadyOpen check — must search after 'page.addLocatorHandler(' to target the handler block.

Issue #724: QA bot testShopSystem found the shop in the Forge page, but the shop moved to a tab inside the Inventory modal (InventoryPanel.tsx tabs INVENTORY/SHOP) -> silently 0 purchases on 87 visits (purchase_rate 0%, shop.simulated null). Fix in qa/qa-bot.mjs only: testShopSystem now (1) opens the inventory modal via button[aria-label=Inventory] instead of navigateToForge, (2) clicks button[role=tab]:has-text(SHOP) inside the modal, (3) keeps offer parsing selectors (.shop-offer-card/.shop-buy-btn/.shop-price — unchanged in ShopPanel.tsx), (4) captures essence_before via parseEssence (.forge-essence-value unchanged), (5) keeps characterLevel < config.shopUnlockLevel gate, (6) suppresses .inventory-overlay handler + re-arms on every exit path (#710 pattern: opened modal requires suppression or the locator handler closes it mid-read), (7) closes modal via .inventory-close instead of leaveForge. 3 new source-content contract tests in qa-analysis.test.ts (modal flow, handler suppress/re-arm counts, close-not-leaveForge). NOTE: isTabLocked() still works for the modal SHOP tab (InventoryPanel tab has BOTH disabled attr when locked AND title='Unlocks at LVL 5'). Pattern: when a game UI element moves to a different container (page->modal, tab->tab), audit the QA bot's navigation step first, and remember the modal-specific locator handler suppression requirement.

Issue #723 PvE balance fix: STAT_MULTIPLIER 20->1.0, HP_MULTIPLIER 22->1.0 (LEVEL_BOOST=3 kept). QA showed idle 2.8% win rate (71 fights, 0 wins) because raw monster stats ~200 vs player ~10 after x20/x22 multipliers -> player dealt min-clamp 20 dmg vs 2000-8000 HP pools, mathematically unbeatable. Monte-Carlo verification (200 runs/level, naked player): LVL1 100%, LVL3 73%, LVL5 83%, LVL10 84%, LVL15 75%, LVL20 49%, LVL25 53%, LVL30 41% — early game (where all QA runs sit, avg end level ~2.5) now winnable, matches targets (PvE 70-85%, idle 40-70%). Gotchas: (1) gameRules.test.ts had hardcoded toBe(20.0)/toBe(22.0) AND toBeGreaterThan(1) assertions — both replaced when multiplier drops to 1.0; (2) regression test 'typical early player beats goblin' with flat-10 stats / HP100 was FLAKY (95.6% win rate over 2000 sims -> ~36% chance of >=1 loss over 10 iterations). Fixed by modeling a realistic fresh player (stats 12, HP 150 = 66 allocated points) which wins 100% over 2000 sims. Pattern: when asserting 'player should win' against a monster, model a REAL fresh character (generated with 66 points), not flat baseline stats — flat-10 is weaker than any real character and makes the test RNG-flaky. Patch note added as 5.4.1. 1443 tests green, lint + build OK.

Issue #730 analyze-qa-stats cumulative false positives: alerts (issues/suggestions) must use recent windows, not all-time cumulative data. 4 fixes: (1) error-rate alerts use last 30 runs (stats.slice(-RECENT_WINDOW_RUNS)) while report keeps all-time error_runs; (2) idle win-rate alerts use last 15 idle-data runs (collectIdleFights helper shared between all-time aggregation and recent window) — all-time 23% included pre-#727 era but last 15 = 79%; (3) PvE XP ratio suggestion gated behind !pve_analysis.pve_shifted (pre-shift monster fights #705 are stale); (4) stats-balance suggestions skip non-stat keys via STAT_KEYS whitelist ['str','vit','dex','luk','int','foc'] — QA bot structured parse captures 'fights' counter (StatsPanel .compact-stat-label FIGHTS) which triggered 'Average initial FIGHTS is 0.0 — consider raising STATS.MIN_VALUE'. Also annotated XP win/loss ratio suggestion as matchmaking symptom (#570/#725). Pattern: when a cumulative metric contradicts recent health, add a recent-window alert path (mirror helper + source-contract test, following #637/#645/#696/#705 patterns). Test gotcha: assertion string 'recentHalfwayRuns.filter(isHalfwayRun)' was wrong — the variable is computed FROM recentRuns (recentRuns.filter(isHalfwayRun)).
